name: Desktop Shell Migration to Tribunus Cockpit
description: Replace the inherited opencode desktop personality with Tribunus cockpit components. Old screens are replaced as they're touched. New features use the Lit component system. The desktop remains the execution authority but its UI surface transitions to the unified design language over time.
purpose: Eliminate the inherited opencode visual grammar from the desktop app. Every screen eventually speaks Tribunus.
acceptanceCriteria: New features exclusively use Lit domain components
Old opencode screens replaced when touched — no big-bang rewrite
Desktop remains execution authority during migration
Two rendering engines coexist during transition (documented, not permanent)
All new cockpit panels bind to PGlite live queries
